blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Center for International Law (CenterLaw) on Monday urged the Court of Appeals (CA) to resolve pending appeals in the Maguindanao massacre case and called on the government to provide reparations to victims’ families, as the country marked 17 years since the killing of 58 people, including 32 journalists and media workers. In a statement issued on the massacre’s anniversary, the nonprofit legal advocacy group said the December 19, 2019, convictions of several perpetrators by the Quezon City Regional Trial Court (RTC) had not brought a complete resolution to the case, with appeals concerning the convictions and […]...
